description:
The `benchbox compare` command's interactive file comparison mode needs significant
UX improvements. Currently it shows a flat list of JSON files with just paths,
requiring users to manually identify which results they want to compare.

Users should be able to either:
A) Specify files directly by path (keep existing behavior)
B) Interactively filter by benchmark/platform/scale, then select from the 10
   most recent matching results

This makes the compare workflow much more intuitive for users with many result
files accumulated over time.
